SRC-119:R001.text: Add immutable runtime provenance for model benchmarking without conflating identities: preserve executor_identity (the stable SAIPEN seat, e.g. astra) and record runtime_provider, runtime_model, and runtime_effort separately on canonical session evidence. These values may come only from an authoritative host launch context, never agent/user self-report or inferred defaults. If host metadata is unavailable, mark provenance and benchmark evidence unavailable/incomplete rather than guessing. Keep provenance append-only/tamper-evident across checkpoints and restarts.
